business_scope.primary_industry_name: Zinc Alloy Die-Casting and Tampo Printing of 1:18 Scale Car Replicas

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Samoa is not a major bilateral investment treaty jurisdiction; the relevant regional trade and investment facilitation instrument is the Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus). No substantive double taxation agreement is relied upon for tax-exempt International Companies.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987, as amended; Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007, as amended; Financial Intelligence Unit Regulations; International Companies (Registered Agent) Regulations; Samoa FIU AML/CFT Guidelines for Registered Agents; UBO disclosure obligations imposed under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2018 and prescribed forms issued by the Samoa International Financial Authority.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport pages for all proposed directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed notary public in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bankers' reference letter evidencing legitimate source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Financial institution maintaining the applicant's account

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or foreign register extract for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registrar or companies registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO statutory declaration in the prescribed Samoan registered agent form
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Samoa International Financial Authority licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Executed before a Samoan notary; no external apostille required for domestic execution

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, and authorized signatories against United Nations Security Council consolidated lists, OFAC SDN list, HM Treasury list, Australian DFAT sanctions lists, and Samoa domestic criminal/PEP records. PEP status requires enhanced due diligence on source of wealth and source of funds, senior management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Any positive match or unusual activity is reported to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA) Company Registry and Online Name Clearance Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be expressed in Latin script; English company names are standard. Gagana Samoa (Samoan) names are accepted but must be transliterated into Latin characters. A proposed name must not be identical or misleadingly similar to an existing registered name, and must include an appropriate limited-liability suffix such as 'Limited', 'IC' or 'International Company' where the entity is to be an International Company.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The rejected applicant may file a formal written reconsideration request with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of the rejection notice. The Registrar must issue a written determination within 21 days. If the name is still refused, the applicant may appeal by originating motion to the Supreme Court of Samoa within 30 days of the Registrar's final determination.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A fully virtual office is not permissible as the statutory address. The International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Samoa at the premises of a licensed registered agent. Shared serviced office spaces used by the registered agent are acceptable; the company need not maintain employees or physical operations in Samoa, and remote management is compliant for this tax-exempt non-resident international company.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low quantified base risk of approximately 5% for a standard non-licensed, low-risk offshore holding/manufacturing order desk entity. The likelihood rises to 10-15% if the UBO file is incomplete, adverse media appears, or the company is selected by the Samoa FIU for compliance inspection. Unannounced physical inspections may be conducted only under statutory authority of the Registrar or FIU.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended: ss.4-8 (incorporation and certificate of incorporation); s.9 (memorandum of association); s.12 (registered office and licensed registered agent); ss.35-42 (shares, directors and first directors); s.70 (annual return requirements)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation as an International Company, filed together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, registered agent consent, and declarations
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement. An International Company may be incorporated with zero or nominal issued capital; shares may be issued in any currency. A licensed registered agent and registered office in Samoa are mandatory.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the shares comprising the initial share capital of the Company, as set out in the Memorandum of Association, are hereby allotted to the subscribers identified in the Application; RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company is established at the office of the licensed registered agent in Samoa until changed by special resolution; RESOLVED that [name] and [name] be appointed as the first directors and that [name] be appointed corporate secretary, each to hold office under the Articles; RESOLVED that the directors are authorized to adopt the Company seal, open bank accounts, engage auditors, and take all steps necessary to obtain business and environmental registrations for the die-casting operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Name Reservation Unit, via licensed International Company registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the licensed registered agent to submit a proposed company name through SIFA's electronic filing system. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to a name already registered in Samoa. SIFA searches the register and, if acceptable, reserves the name for 90 days. The agent files the name reservation and receives a formal clearance reference.
required_dossiers: Passport or certified ID of subscriber/beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused for conflict or undesirability, the agent files an alternative name immediately; no SIFA processing fee applies until a name is successfully cleared.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed International Company registered agent in Samoa (statutory notarization not required; agent attestation is accepted)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, including objects, share capital, and governance provisions required by ss.9-14 of the International Companies Act 1987. The subscriber signs the documents before a witness; the registered agent countersigns to certify the signatures and to confirm that the company will maintain its registered office and agent in Samoa. Initial directors sign consents.
required_dossiers: Consent and appointment of first director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the documents contain a defect, the agent prepares a correcting amendment and re-executes the affected pages before resubmission; no new subscriber consent is required for immaterial typographical corrections.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application to SIFA
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, SIFA, Apia (physical counter or SIFA online filing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IC-1 together with executed Memorandum and Articles, consents, and declarations. The registered agent certifies each copy as a true copy of the original. Government fees are payable by bank transfer to the SIFA trust account. After submission, SIFA assigns a lodgement number and conducts statutory compliance review.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of registered agent consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIFA issues a query letter, the agent files written responses and amended documents within 14 days; if the appointment of agent lapses, the agent reinstates consent to avoid rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar enters the company in the International Companies Register, assigns the registration number, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The company comes into existence on the certificate date and the registered agent updates the statutory registers, opens the corporate file, and delivers the certificate and minute book to the client.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is delayed or contains a data mismatch, the agent submits a written correction request to the Registrar; if the company is rejected, the agent files a fresh application using the same name and no adverse record attaches.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Corporate Governance and Bank Account Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent in coordination with the first directors and a licensed Samoa or offshore bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or adopt a written resolution to allot shares, approve the registered office, appoint officers, adopt the seal, open bank accounts, and authorize signing authorities. File the notice of first directors and any changes to SIFA, and maintain registers of members, directors, and charges at the registered office. Obtain bank introduction from the agent with certified corporate documents.
required_dossiers: Register of members and share allotment
Certificate of incorporation and charter documents
Bank account opening forms and KYC files
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the ultimate beneficial ownership, provide an updated ownership chart and certification from the licensed agent; if the Registrar rejects the officers notice, file a corrected notice within 5 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial, Environmental and Civil Defense Clearances for Manufacturing Operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) - Business Licence and Trade Division; Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE); Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority; Planning and Urban Management Agency
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before physical production, obtain a Business Operating Licence under the Business Licences Act 1998 for the factory address. For die-casting operations, submit an environmental registration to MNRE confirming the low-impact nature of zinc alloy melting and tampo printing. Obtain building occupancy approval and Fire Safety Certificate for the leased factory unit. Compile an OHS risk assessment for the die-casting equipment and work premises.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement or title of factory premises
Environmental registration form and process description
OHS risk assessment and workplace registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a consent condition is imposed, implement a corrective action plan and request amended approval; appeals are available to MCIL or the relevant authority within 21 days of any refusal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) - Business Licence and Trade Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Operating Licence under the Business Licences Act 1998 (Samoa), covering low-risk manufacturing of zinc alloy die-cast scale models

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Samoa Environment Protection Agency, Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - Environmental Registration/Screening; full EIA Report not required for low-impact die-casting under 100 tonnes annual zinc throughput
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge: pH 6-9, total suspended solids below 50 mg/L, total zinc below 5 mg/L before release; stack particulate matter below 50 mg/m3; waste flux, slag and ink residues handled as controlled waste under the Waste Management Act 2005 with manifest records

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority; structural load inspection and building occupancy permit from the Planning and Urban Management Agency; workplace OHS registration and risk assessment under the Samoa Occupational Safety and Health Act 2011

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue of Samoa (MfR), Apia; online filing portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: International Companies under the International Companies Act 1987 are statutorily non-resident and exempt from Samoan income tax, stamp duty, and exchange control; they do not require a domestic TIN for normal offshore activities. The Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar of International Companies serves as the statutory identity identifier. A foreign entity engaging in local VAGST registrable activities must submit the prescribed MfR registration forms (including Form VAGST-1 and TIN application) supported by the certificate of incorporation, constitutional documents, director identification, and a local address or registered agent confirmation; the Ministry issues a nine-digit Inland Revenue taxpayer number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None available. Samoa does not operate a US-style check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election regime. International Companies are statutorily classified as non-resident tax-exempt entities and may not elect to be treated as ordinary resident taxpayers; general anti-avoidance rules under the Tax Administration Act 2012 apply to any purported election or structure seeking domestic tax advantages.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: SAT 100,000 (annual taxable turnover threshold under the VAGST Act 1998, as amended)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Samoa does not mandate real-time fiscal clearance, API-based e-invoicing, or digital stamping. Registered suppliers must issue sequential tax invoices (paper or electronic PDF), retain them for at least six years, and file periodic VAGST returns (generally bi-monthly) through the Ministry for Revenue online portal or physical submission.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to supplies of goods physically exported from Samoa within the prescribed statutory period (goods must leave Samoa within 21 days of supply, or 60 days for specially manufactured goods, with satisfactory evidence). Services may be zero-rated when supplied to a non-resident for use wholly outside Samoa. For the die-cast scale automotive model business, each shipment must be an outright sale to a non-resident customer, with no local consumption, storage, installation, or further supply in Samoa before export.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration lodged with the Samoa Customs Service
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical removal of goods from Samoa
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit record proving foreign-exchange repatriation
Original commercial invoice and signed packing list
Certificate of Origin (where required by destination jurisdiction)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry for Revenue may reassess an export zero-rating claim as a taxable supply at 15% VAGST where export documentation is incomplete, goods are diverted into the Samoan market, or foreign-exchange proceeds are not repatriated within the prescribed period. Civil penalties under the Tax Administration Act 2012 include shortfall penalties based on conduct (from 20% to 100% of the unpaid tax), late-payment penalties, and interest. Fraudulent export zero-rating, false declarations, forged inward remittance evidence, or fictitious exports expose the company and its officers to criminal prosecution, substantial fines, and imprisonment; the VAGST refund is clawed back with interest from the date of the original claim.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) — Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa; Exchange Control Act 1976; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Prohibition of Financing of Terrorism Act 2017; Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) for international-company licensing
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) operates under a CBS-managed basket peg with limited offshore deliverability. Current-account payments are freely convertible upon documented underlying transactions. Capital-account transfers by resident persons require CBS exchange-control approval; however, an International Company (IC) maintaining an External Account is treated as non-resident, enabling unrestricted convertibility and profit remittance of WST/USD/EUR balances without a CBS permit. The only practical hurdle is the lack of an active offshore WST market, which compels USD or AUD as the functional treasury currency.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control (Export) Regulations, resident exporters must surrender export proceeds into Samoa within 3 months of shipment unless an External Account exemption is granted. A non-resident IC is not subject to the mandatory surrender ratio and may retain 100% of receipts in a designated foreign-currency proceeds account. Each inward credit must be matched against a commercial invoice, packing list, and bill of lading to satisfy CBS reporting and bank-level AML documentary requirements.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: External Account (Operational) and Capital Escrow Sub-account
External Account (Operational) and Trade Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BSP Bank Samoa (BSP Financial Group Ltd, formerly ANZ Bank Samoa)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: External Account (Operational) with FX and Money-Market Lines

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Low. Major offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Revolut Business, Mercury, Airwallex) do not support Samoa-incorporated International Companies, citing correspondent-bank de-risking and the zero-tax offshore status. PayPal Business is viable only as a customer-collection payment link, not as a treasury clearing rail. The bank-replacement-EMI path is therefore not feasible; a hybrid stack of PayPal (retail collections) plus SWIFT USD through a licensed Samoan commercial bank is the recommended structure.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory mandate requires directors of an International Company to appear physically in Samoa; CMS regulations permit risk-based remote onboarding for non-resident ICs. In practice, Bank of Samoa and Samoa Commercial Bank require at least one authorised signatory to attend a video interview with the compliance officer and to route notarised and apostilled/legalised identification through a licensed Samoan registered agent or trust company; a fully remote opening is available only when the IC appoints a Samoan-resident authorised signatory. BSP Bank Samoa will accept fully remote onboarding for low-risk UBOs subject to a bank-confirmed video interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Registered-agent and nominee-director structure obscuring the Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified extracts from the IC's Register of Directors and Register of Shareholders; SIFA Certificate of Good Standing; UBO Declaration under AML/CFT Act 2017; notarised passport copies and utility bills of all UBOs; corporate chart showing ownership chain to natural persons.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt IC status flagged as a tax-haven red flag during account underwriting
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation under the International Companies Act 2019; SIFA compliance letter confirming valid status; substantive-activity evidence for ISIC 3240 (zinc alloy die-casting purchase orders, tamppo printing contracts, bills of lading, ISO 9001 certificate); group organisational chart proving production and sales occur outside Samoa.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions/PEP screening alert on the Chinese or regional manufacturing supply chain used for die-cast production
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OFAC/UN/EU sanctions screening reports for all counterparties; supplier AML declarations and business licences; notarised purchase and mould-tooling contracts; shipping documents aligning with trade purpose codes; external counsel sanctions opinion.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspicious rapid inbound capital injection inconsistent with declared share capital
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financials of the ultimate parent; source-of-funds and source-of-wealth reports; bank reference letters from the originating bank (dated within 3 months); board resolution approving the equity injection and allotment; explanation of the die-cast tooling capex requirement in the 1:18 scale replica product line.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: UEllect equity injection, and any intercompany loan, must be routed via SWIFT MT103 in USD, EUR, or AUD to the IC's External Account at the Samoan commercial bank, with remittance narrative 'SHARE SUBSCRIPTION — ICA 2019' or 'INTERCOMPANY LOAN'. The receiving bank credits the Capital Escrow sub-account after verifying the board resolution, share allotment form, and source of funds; no CBS exchange-control approval is required for non-resident IC equity. A SWIFT MT199 pre-advice to the beneficiary bank, followed by the MT103, mitigates clearing delays; retain the bank-issued credit confirmation and the approved cash-flow schedule for future repatriation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier settlements for zinc alloy, tampping inks, and packaging are executed via SWIFT MT103 (USD) with commercial purpose code 'Goods trade settlement — ISIC 3240', cleared over the correspondent bank's nostro network (commonly Westpac or BNZ/US clearing aggregator). For mould-tooling and large die-cast machine purchases above USD 50,000, an irrevocable documentary Letter of Credit (UCP 600) at sight or 90-day tenor is recommended. PayPal serves as a supplementary rail for small-volume customer receivables. The treasury desk should consolidate disbursements into weekly batch MT103s to reduce FX conversion and correspondent fees.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright USD/WST forward with tenor up to 12 months and documented underlying trade exposure
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) on USD/WST executed offshore, as WST has no active deliverable offshore market
Cross-currency swap between USD and WST (limited counterparty appetite; requires CBS confirmation for resident legs only)
Plain-vanilla USD/WST FX options (buy-side only) for invoice and capital-repatriation protection

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (International Companies Act 1987, s.134) — prescribed form covering corporate particulars, authorized and issued share capital, members, directors and compliance declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after each incorporation anniversary (e.g., incorporated 15 March — filing due by 14 September in each subsequent year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty (fixed statutory fine plus a continuing daily default fine); failure to file within the six-month window renders the company liable to strike-off — the Registrar publishes an intention to strike off in the Savali (Official Gazette) and the company is dissolved three months after the gazette notice unless the annual return and fees are brought current

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Fee (annual renewal of the International Company registration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia, Samoa (collected on behalf of the Government of Samoa)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on each incorporation anniversary; a 90-day grace period applies before late penalty charging
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of approximately 10% of the annual fee after the 90-day grace period; fees unpaid for 12 months from the due date enable the Registrar to strike off the company, with dissolution effective three months after the gazetted notice

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Beneficial Ownership (confidential UBO return filed through the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies (confidential beneficial ownership register), MCIL, Apia, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the annual return (within six months after incorporation anniversary); any change in beneficial ownership, share transfer or control arrangement must be reported within 14 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or incomplete filing constitutes a statutory offence with monetary fines per continuing day of default; the annual return is not accepted until the UBO confirmation is current, and the registered agent's licence is at risk for persistent non-compliance

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit for a standard, non-regulated International Company under the International Companies Act 1987; an audit becomes mandatory only if (a) the company's articles of incorporation require it, (b) the company is listed on a recognized securities exchange, or (c) the company holds a license under separate financial-services legislation (bank, insurance, or trust services)
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (as adopted internationally) for any required or voluntarily commissioned audit; non-audited International Companies must maintain accounting records sufficient to explain transactions and disclose the financial position with reasonable accuracy, customarily maintained on a double-entry basis

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent performs annual client due diligence and lodges/updates the confidential beneficial ownership return with the Registrar on the incorporation-anniversary cycle; the agent must capture any share transfer or trust arrangement change within 14 days and attach the annual UBO confirmation to the annual return before the six-month deadline

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 - 1,200 per annum (licensed registered agent and registered office services)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - 6,000 per annum (voluntary audit or review; not a statutory requirement for this entity)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% effective rate for registered International Companies; 27% statutory headline rate for resident general companies under the Income Tax Act 2014
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies Act 2018 (re-enacting ICA 1987 s.145) confers an absolute and indefinite exemption from income tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, estate duty, and exchange control on all income derived from international business; no minimum capital requirement; no CFC regime, thin capitalization rules, or local licence taxes apply to an exempt IC; income sourced in Samoa is excluded from the exemption and would be taxed at 27% if the IC breaches its non-resident trading status

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return and Government Fee Statement (Form SIFSC-IC/AR-1); filed through the Samoa International Financial Services Centre (SIFSC) online registry portal (Companies Online eRegistration)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after the anniversary date of incorporation; the annual Government fee must be remitted at the same time, and continued default triggers automatic strike-off

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A - Company number and name
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registry number, exact legal name, date of incorporation, and jurisdiction of incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors must verify the registry number precisely; an IC is not required to hold a Samoan tax file number because it is outside the income tax net

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box B - Registered office and registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address in Samoa and the name of the licensed registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The IC must at all times retain a Samoan-registered agent; the agent is jointly responsible for registry filings and AML screening of UBOs

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box C - Directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal names, nationalities, residential addresses, and shareholding percentages of all directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee shareholders and directors are permissible, but the UBO register must be disclosed to the FIU and Registrar on demand; false entries attract criminal liability

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of whether the IC carries on a relevant activity under the Economic Substance Regulations 2019 (banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing/leasing, headquarters, distribution and service centre, holding company, or IP holding)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A die-cast automotive model IC that purchases finished goods from a connected Chinese foundry and resells worldwide must declare distribution and service centre activity; declaring 'no relevant activity' while trading is a criminal misrepresentation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box E - No local business confirmation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the IC will not carry on trade with Samoan residents or derive income from sources within Samoa
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any local Samoan-source turnover forfeits the exemption and exposes the IC to full income tax filing requirements; the IC should obtain a written advisory opinion before onboarding Samoan-resident dealers

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of 10% of the annual Government fee per commenced month of default, capped at 100% of the fee; three months of continued non-payment results in automatic deregistration; assets of a deregistered IC escheat to the Crown; the registered agent is separately liable for a fine not exceeding WST 100,000

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Samoa Income Tax Return - Company (Form CIT-1); lodged via the Inland Revenue Department e-filing portal (IRD Samoa eServices)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a standard 30 June year of income, the return is due no later than 30 November of the same calendar year (within five months of balance date); extended dates require written approval from the Commissioner

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total assessable income derived from all sources, including gross turnover and foreign-source receipts
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An exempt IC reports nil; if the IC has inadvertently derived Samoan-source income, that income must be declared in full

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income subject to statutory exemption, including international business income of an IC
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a copy of the Certificate of Incorporation and the annual substance declaration; the burden of proving exemption rests on the taxpayer

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Expenses directly incurred in producing assessable income, excluding capital, private, and non-allowable expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents may deduct only expenses attributable to Samoan-source income; intercompany charges must satisfy the arm's length standard
For an exempt IC this is always nil absent a breach of the ICA restrictions

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax computed at the statutory rate on taxable income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the 27% rate only if the IC lost its exemption; otherwise enter zero

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for Samoan WHT withheld from interest, dividends, or royalties
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach Form WHT-2 certificates received from the payer and compute credits in WST at the exchange rate on the payment date

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 - Net tax payable or refund
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax at Box 5 less credits at Box 6
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any residual liability must be paid on assessment; late payment accrues a 2% monthly penalty

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of WST 1,000 plus WST 20 per day of default; late payment penalty of 2% per month compounded; deliberate understatement attracts a penalty of up to 200% of the tax shortfall, plus criminal prosecution with imprisonment up to seven years

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% where the payer is an exempt International Company, as such distributions are not Samoan-source income and fall outside the Income Tax Act 2014; 15% where the payer is a resident general company distributing dividends to a non-resident shareholder
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Samoa's ratified double taxation agreements cover Australia and New Zealand; treaty rates generally reduce Samoan dividend WHT on portfolio shareholdings to 15% and on substantial shareholdings to 5%, with interest and royalties at 10%; to invoke relief, the beneficial owner must lodge Form WHT-3 (Application for Treaty Relief) with the Commissioner of Inland Revenue before the payment date, attaching a Samoa Tax Residency Certificate issued by the IRD, a completed counterparty tax officer certificate, a signed beneficial ownership declaration, and a legal memorandum applying the DTA article; the Commissioner must approve the relief in writing; relief is denied where the shareholder is not the beneficial owner or lacks substance in the residence jurisdiction
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Samoan WHT: 15% on interest and 15% on royalties paid by a resident payer to a non-resident; treaty rate under the Australia and New Zealand DTAs: 10% for both interest and royalties; payments of interest or royalties by an exempt International Company carry zero Samoan WHT because the payer is not within the Samoan tax base; no Samoa-China DTA exists, so a Chinese parent or IP owner cannot claim domestic treaty relief and remains subject to the instrument-specific rules of its own tax jurisdiction

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No formal Local File or Master File regime exists under Samoa domestic law for International Companies; the general arm's length principle applies to cross-border related-party dealings under the Income Tax Act 2014; prudent contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation is recommended wherever annual related-party turnover exceeds WST 2,000,000 or where intercompany IP royalties exceed WST 500,000, and such documentation is mandatory for treaty relief applications and ESR evaluations
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Regulations 2019 (as amended 2021) require any IC carrying on a relevant activity to demonstrate sufficient economic substance in Samoa. An IC that purchases zinc die-cast and tampo-printed 1:18 scale replicas from a connected Chinese manufacturer and sells them to global distributors is classified as a distribution and service centre, requiring core income-generating activities in Samoa, including strategic board-level management, contract negotiation, logistics and inventory control, and risk management. The IC must maintain a physical office in Samoa, employ adequate full-time staff, and incur adequate operating expenditure; a pure equity holding IC needs only registry compliance. Failure to meet the substance test attracts an administrative penalty of up to WST 500,000 and mandatory strike-off from the register, and the Registrar must notify the exchange of information partner.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion through abuse of International Company exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the tax-exempt IC to conceal Samoan domestic trading, channeling local sales through the IC's PayPal or Swift accounts, backdating transactions to maintain a sham international status, or understating related-party revenues to hide a Samoan permanent establishment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of up to 200% of the tax avoided plus daily default penalties; forfeiture of the ICA exemption with retrospective assessment at 27% for all concealed income; freezing orders against bank accounts; deregistration of the IC
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, registered agents, and beneficial owners who knowingly participate are personally and jointly liable for civil restitution of unpaid taxes; the Commissioner may issue departure prohibition orders imposing travel bans; criminal conviction carries imprisonment of up to seven years

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company and sham economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Registering as a mere nominee shell while in fact carrying on distribution, headquarters, or IP-holding activity; filing a false Box D declaration stating no relevant activity; failing to maintain a Samoan office, staff, or board meetings where the ESR requires it
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty up to WST 500,000; compulsory strike-off and dissolution; disgorgement of profits derived during the period of non-compliance; referral to the Financial Intelligence Unit for coordinated AML action
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed false substance declarations are personally liable for the penalty and restitution; the court may disqualify them from acting as directors for up to ten years; false declarations carry imprisonment of up to five years

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money laundering and unlicensed payment activity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing Swift wire or PayPal proceeds from sanctioned persons, drug trade, fraud, or tax evasion through the IC's accounts; operating as an unlicensed money services business by receiving and paying third-party funds; failing to file suspicious transaction reports with the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines of up to WST 7,000,000 under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007; restraint and confiscation orders over all assets, including the entire share capital of the IC; deregistration and blacklisting of the registered agent
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and signatories are criminally liable for acts of laundering committed with knowledge or reckless disregard; imprisonment of up to 14 years; personal assets may be confiscated; travel bans and extradition cooperation apply
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.compulsory_administrative_liabilities: The SIFSC Registrar may disqualify the authorized agent and strike off the entity without court proceedings; non-resident principals remain exposed to parallel criminal charges in the buyer jurisdiction

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Breach of shareholder and director UBO disclosure obligations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing an annual return with false, incomplete, or outdated ultimate beneficial ownership information; continuing to operate after a change of control without notifying the registered agent and the Registrar; refusing to provide the UBO register to the FIU
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine not exceeding WST 500,000 against the company; daily penalty of WST 1,000 for each day the register remains defective; deregistration in the case of persistent breach
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each director and the registered agent are separately prosecuted; personal fines up to WST 100,000 and imprisonment up to two years; directors remain personally liable to creditors if the company is struck off while liabilities are unpaid
